summary: The stakeholder urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding and opposes proposed rule changes that could negatively impact access to educational and library resources.

claims.argument: E-Rate is fulfilling its intended purpose by helping schools and libraries provide essential broadband access to their communities
claims.evidence_quote: I urge the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding and reject the proposed rule changes in Proceedings 26-133 and 13-184.
